   168→# Test Flow 3: Feedback Loop (test-loop)

   172→    version: '1.0.0'

   174→    description: 'Tests onFailure.goto with a test step that fails twice then succeeds'
   175→    workspace:
   176→        mode: manual
   177→        gitStrategy: any
   178→        reusePolicy: always
   179→    statusTransitions:
   180→        onSuccess: approved

   211→# Test Flow 4: Review Feedback Loop (test-review-loop)
   212→# Tests onFailure.goto with a review step that provides feedback
   213→# Flow: implement → review (fails 1st, passes 2nd) → deploy
   214→test-review-loop:
   215→    version: '1.0.0'
   216→    name: 'Test: Review Feedback Loop'
   217→    description: 'Tests onFailure.goto with a review step that fails once then approves'
   218→    workspace:
   219→        mode: manual
   220→        gitStrategy: any
   221→        reusePolicy: always
   222→    statusTransitions:
   223→        onSuccess: approved
   224→        onFailure: changes_requested
   225→    inputs:

   234→
   235→        # Step 2: review (fails first time with feedback, passes second time)
   236→        - type: script
   237→          id: review
   238→          name: 'Code Review'
   239→          depends: [implement]
   240→          onFailure:
   241→              goto: implement
   242→              maxIterations: 2
   243→          script: |
   244→              echo [review] Starting code review... && ping localhost -n 2 >nul && if not exist review-iter1.tmp (echo [review] CHANGES REQUESTED: Please add error handling && echo. > review-iter1.tmp && echo. > review-feedback.tmp && exit /b 1) else (echo [review] Code review APPROVED! All issues addressed && del review-iter1.tmp 2>nul && exit /b 0)

   246→        # Step 3: deploy (only runs after review passes)

   249→          name: 'Deploy to Production'
   250→          depends: [review]
   251→          script: |
   252→              echo [deploy] Deploying approved code to production... && ping localhost -n 3 >nul && echo [deploy] Deployment successful!
   253→
   254→# Test Flow 5: Multi-Review with skipOnLoop and resetOnSuccess
   255→# Tests advanced loop features: multiple reviews, some skipped on retry
   256→# Flow: implement → (quality + security + consistency + usability) → deploy
   257→test-multi-review:
   258→    version: '1.0.0'
   259→    name: 'Test: Multi-Review with Skip and Reset'
   260→    description: 'Tests skipOnLoop and resetOnSuccess with parallel review steps'
   261→    workspace:
   262→        mode: manual
   263→        gitStrategy: any
   264→        reusePolicy: always

   266→        onSuccess: approved

   292→          depends: [implement]

   399→# Recursive flow: Countdown from N to 0
   400→test-recursive-countdown:
   401→    version: '1.0.0'
   402→    name: 'Test: Recursive Countdown'
   403→    description: 'Tests recursive SubFlowStep with exit condition (counts from N to 0)'
   404→    workspace:
   405→        mode: manual
   406→        gitStrategy: any
   407→        reusePolicy: always
   408→    inputs:
   409→        count: string
   410→    steps:
   411→        - type: script
   412→          id: display
   413→          name: 'Display Count'
   414→          script: 'echo "Count: ${{ inputs.count }}"'
   415→
   416→        - type: script
   417→          id: calculate
   418→          name: 'Calculate Next'
   419→          script: |
   420→              set /a next=${{ inputs.count }}-1 >nul
   421→              echo next=%next%
   422→              if %next% GEQ 0 (echo continue=true) else (echo continue=false)

   669→# Example 5: Complex Fan-Out Fan-In
   670→data-fanout-fanin:
   671→    version: '1.0.0'
   672→    name: 'Data Flow: Fan-Out/Fan-In'
   673→    description: 'Complex pattern with multiple parallel transformations and aggregation'
   674→    workspace:
   675→        mode: manual
   676→        gitStrategy: any
   677→        reusePolicy: always
   678→    inputs:
   679→        dataset: string
   680→    steps:
   681→        - type: script
   682→          id: prepare
   683→          name: 'Prepare Dataset'
   684→          script: |
   685→              echo Preparing dataset: ${{ inputs.dataset }}
   686→              set /a count=100
   687→              set /a total=5000
   688→              echo count=%count%
   689→              echo total=%total%
   690→          output:
   691→              count: { type: string, pattern: 'count=(.*)' }
   692→              total: { type: string, pattern: 'total=(.*)' }
   693→
   694→        # Fan-out: Multiple parallel processors
   695→        - type: script
   696→          id: calc-average
   697→          name: 'Calculate Average'
   698→          depends: [prepare]
   699→          script: |
   700→              echo Calculating average from total=${{ steps.prepare.outputs.total }}, count=${{ steps.prepare.outputs.count }}
   701→              set /a avg=${{ steps.prepare.outputs.total }} / ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.count }}
   702→              echo average=%avg%
   703→          output:
   704→              average: { type: string, pattern: 'average=(.*)' }
   705→
   706→        - type: script
   707→          id: calc-min
   708→          name: 'Find Minimum'
   709→          depends: [prepare]
   710→          script: |
   711→              echo Finding min in dataset
   712→              set /a min=5
   713→              echo min=%min%
   714→          output:
   715→              min: { type: string, pattern: 'min=(.*)' }
   716→
   717→        - type: script
   718→          id: calc-max
   719→          name: 'Find Maximum'
   720→          depends: [prepare]
   721→          script: |
   722→              echo Finding max in dataset
   723→              set /a max=95
   724→              echo max=%max%
   725→          output:
   726→              max: { type: string, pattern: 'max=(.*)' }
   727→
   728→        - type: script
   729→          id: calc-stddev
   730→          name: 'Calculate Std Dev'
   731→          depends: [prepare]
   732→          script: |
   733→              echo Calculating standard deviation
   734→              set /a stddev=15
   735→              echo stddev=%stddev%
   736→          output:
   737→              stddev: { type: string, pattern: 'stddev=(.*)' }
   738→
   739→        # Intermediate: Use some results
   740→        - type: script
   741→          id: calc-range
   742→          name: 'Calculate Range'
   743→          depends: [calc-min, calc-max]
   744→          script: |
   745→              echo Range calculation: max=${{ steps.calc-max.outputs.max }}, min=${{ steps.calc-min.outputs.min }}
   746→              set /a range=${{ steps.calc-max.outputs.max }} - ${{ steps.calc-min.outputs.min }}
   747→              echo range=%range%
   748→          output:
   749→              range: { type: string, pattern: 'range=(.*)' }
   750→
   751→        # Fan-in: Aggregate all statistics
   752→        - type: script
   753→          id: generate-report
   754→          name: 'Generate Statistics Report'
   755→          depends: [calc-average, calc-range, calc-stddev]
   756→          script: |
   757→              echo === Statistics Report ===
   758→              echo Dataset: ${{ inputs.dataset }}
   759→              echo Count: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.count }}
   760→              echo Total: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.total }}
   761→              echo Average: ${{ steps.calc-average.outputs.average }}
   762→              echo Min: ${{ steps.calc-min.outputs.min }}
   763→              echo Max: ${{ steps.calc-max.outputs.max }}
   764→              echo Range: ${{ steps.calc-range.outputs.range }}
   765→              echo StdDev: ${{ steps.calc-stddev.outputs.stddev }}
   766→              echo report=generated
   767→          output:
   768→              report: { type: string, pattern: 'report=(.*)' }

   770→# Example 6: Conditional Data Flow
   771→data-conditional:

  1171→# ============================================================================
  1172→# IDEA REFINER FLOW
  1173→# Transform high-level ideas into actionable flows and tickets
  1174→# ============================================================================
  1175→
  1176→idea-refiner:
  1177→    version: '1.0.0'
  1178→    name: 'Idea Refiner: Transform Ideas into Flows and Tickets'
  1179→    description: 'Analyzes an idea, recommends/generates flows, and creates structured tickets'
  1180→    workspace:
  1181→        mode: shared
  1182→        gitStrategy: main-only
  1183→        reusePolicy: always
  1184→    statusTransitions:
  1185→        onSuccess: approved
  1186→        onFailure: todo
  1187→    inputs:
  1188→        idea:
  1189→            type: text
  1190→            required: true
  1191→            description: 'High-level idea description'
  1192→        preferExisting:
  1193→            type: boolean
  1194→            required: false
  1195→            default: true
  1196→            description: 'Prefer reusing existing flows over generating new ones'
  1197→    steps:
  1198→        # Step 1: Analyze the idea
  1199→        - type: model
  1200→          id: analyze-idea
  1201→          name: 'Analyze Idea Requirements'
  1202→          model: sonnet
  1203→          prompt: |
  1204→              Analyze this idea and extract structured requirements:
  1205→
  1206→              Idea: ${{ inputs.idea }}
  1207→
  1208→              Extract:
  1209→              1. Core objective (what does it aim to achieve?)
  1210→              2. Required inputs (what data/parameters are needed?)
  1211→              3. Expected outputs (what should be produced?)
  1212→              4. Complexity level (simple/medium/complex)
  1213→              5. Suggested flow patterns (pipeline/conditional/loop/fan-out/etc)
  1214→              6. Required features (user approval? parallel execution? retries?)
  1215→
  1216→              Return as JSON with fields: objective, inputs, outputs, complexity, patterns, features.
  1217→              Example:
  1218→              {
  1219→                "objective": "Deploy application to production",
  1220→                "inputs": ["environment", "version"],
  1221→                "outputs": ["deploymentUrl", "status"],
  1222→                "complexity": "medium",
  1223→                "patterns": ["build-pipeline", "user-intervention"],
  1224→                "features": {
  1225→                  "userApproval": true,
  1226→                  "parallel": false,
  1227→                  "loops": false
  1228→                }
  1229→              }
  1230→          output:
  1231→              requirements:
  1232→                  type: object
  1233→                  transform: parseJSON
  1234→
  1235→        # Step 2: Search existing flows
  1236→        - type: script
  1237→          id: search-flows
  1238→          name: 'Search for Matching Flows'
  1239→          depends: [analyze-idea]
  1240→          script: node scripts/recommend-flows.js '${{ steps.analyze-idea.outputs.requirements }}'
  1241→          output:
  1242→              recommendations:
  1243→                  type: object
  1244→                  transform: parseJSON
  1245→
  1246→        # Step 3: User decision (reuse, generate, or manual)
  1247→        - type: user_intervention
  1248→          id: flow-decision
  1249→          name: 'Choose Flow Strategy'
  1250→          depends: [search-flows]
  1251→          interventionType: choice
  1252→          blocking: true
  1253→          choice:
  1254→              question: 'How would you like to proceed with this idea?'
  1255→              options:
  1256→                  - id: reuse
  1257→                    label: 'Reuse Existing Flow'
  1258→                    description: 'Adapt one of the recommended flows to match your needs'
  1259→                  - id: generate
  1260→                    label: 'Generate Custom Flow'
  1261→                    description: 'Create a new flow tailored specifically to this idea'
  1262→                  - id: manual
  1263→                    label: 'Create Manually'
  1264→                    description: 'I will create the flow manually using the documentation'
  1265→              allowMultiple: false
  1266→          output:
  1267→              decision: { type: string, from: 'intervention.choice' }
  1268→              selectedFlowId: { type: string, from: 'intervention.metadata.flowId' }
  1269→
  1270→        # Step 4a: Adapt existing flow (if reuse chosen)
  1271→        - type: model
  1272→          id: adapt-flow
  1273→          name: 'Adapt Existing Flow'
  1274→          depends: [flow-decision]
  1275→          when: "${{ steps.flow-decision.outputs.decision === 'reuse' }}"
  1276→          model: sonnet
  1277→          prompt: |
  1278→              Adapt this flow to match the requirements:
  1279→
  1280→              Original Flow:
  1281→              ${{ steps.search-flows.outputs.recommendations[0].flow }}
  1282→
  1283→              Requirements:
  1284→              ${{ steps.analyze-idea.outputs.requirements }}
  1285→
  1286→              Adaptation Suggestions:
  1287→              ${{ steps.search-flows.outputs.recommendations[0].adaptationSuggestions }}
  1288→
  1289→              Provide:
  1290→              1. Modified flow definition (YAML)
  1291→              2. List of changes made
  1292→              3. Rationale for each change
  1293→
  1294→              Return as JSON with fields: flowYaml (string), changes (array), rationale (string).
  1295→          output:
  1296→              flowYaml: { type: string }
  1297→              changes: { type: object, transform: parseJSON }
  1298→
  1299→        # Step 4b: Generate new flow (if generate chosen)
  1300→        - type: script
  1301→          id: generate-flow
  1302→          name: 'Generate Custom Flow'
  1303→          depends: [flow-decision]
  1304→          when: "${{ steps.flow-decision.outputs.decision === 'generate' }}"
  1305→          script: |
  1306→              $requirements = '${{ steps.analyze-idea.outputs.requirements }}'
  1307→              $flowReq = @{
  1308→                  id = "generated-flow-$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss')"
  1309→                  name = "Generated Flow"
  1310→                  description = '${{ inputs.idea }}'
  1311→                  inputs = $requirements.inputs
  1312→                  expectedOutputs = $requirements.outputs
  1313→                  patterns = $requirements.patterns
  1314→                  constraints = $requirements.features
  1315→              } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
  1316→              node scripts/generate-flow.js "$flowReq"
  1317→          output:
  1318→              flowYaml: { type: string }
  1319→              validationReport: { type: object, transform: parseJSON }
  1320→
  1321→        # Step 5: Validate flow (for reuse/generate paths)
  1322→        - type: script
  1323→          id: validate-flow
  1324→          name: 'Validate Flow Definition'
  1325→          depends: [adapt-flow, generate-flow]
  1326→          when: "${{ steps.flow-decision.outputs.decision !== 'manual' }}"
  1327→          script: |
  1328→              $yaml = if ('${{ steps.adapt-flow.outputs.flowYaml }}' -ne '') {
  1329→                  '${{ steps.adapt-flow.outputs.flowYaml }}'
  1330→              } else {
  1331→                  '${{ steps.generate-flow.outputs.flowYaml }}'
  1332→              }
  1333→              node scripts/validate-flow.js "$yaml"
  1334→          output:
  1335→              isValid: { type: boolean }
  1336→              errors: { type: object, transform: parseJSON }
  1337→              warnings: { type: object, transform: parseJSON }
  1338→
  1339→        # Step 6: Generate tickets
  1340→        - type: model
  1341→          id: generate-tickets
  1342→          name: 'Generate Structured Tickets'
  1343→          depends: [flow-decision, validate-flow]
  1344→          model: sonnet
  1345→          prompt: |
  1346→              Generate structured tickets for implementing this idea:
  1347→
  1348→              Original Idea: ${{ inputs.idea }}
  1349→              Requirements: ${{ steps.analyze-idea.outputs.requirements }}
  1350→              Flow Strategy: ${{ steps.flow-decision.outputs.decision }}
  1351→
  1352→              Flow YAML (if applicable):
  1353→              ${{ steps.adapt-flow.outputs.flowYaml || steps.generate-flow.outputs.flowYaml }}
  1354→
  1355→              Validation Results:
  1356→              Valid: ${{ steps.validate-flow.outputs.isValid }}
  1357→              Errors: ${{ steps.validate-flow.outputs.errors }}
  1358→
  1359→              Create tickets with:
  1360→              - Title (clear, actionable)
  1361→              - Description (detailed context)
  1362→              - Acceptance criteria (specific, testable)
  1363→              - Dependencies (what must be done first)
  1364→              - Estimated complexity (1-5 scale)
  1365→              - Labels/tags
  1366→
  1367→              Return as JSON array:
  1368→              [
  1369→                {
  1370→                  "title": "Ticket title",
  1371→                  "description": "Detailed description",
  1372→                  "acceptanceCriteria": ["Criterion 1", "Criterion 2"],
  1373→                  "dependencies": ["ticket-id-1"],
  1374→                  "complexity": 3,
  1375→                  "labels": ["backend", "api"]
  1376→                }
  1377→              ]
  1378→          output:
  1379→              tickets:
  1380→                  type: object
  1381→                  transform: parseJSON
  1382→
  1383→        # Step 7: Present results
  1384→        - type: model
  1385→          id: present-results
  1386→          name: 'Present Results Summary'
  1387→          depends: [generate-tickets]
  1388→          model: haiku
  1389→          prompt: |
  1390→              Create a summary of the idea refinement process:
  1391→
  1392→              Idea: ${{ inputs.idea }}
  1393→              Strategy: ${{ steps.flow-decision.outputs.decision }}
  1394→              Tickets Generated: ${{ steps.generate-tickets.outputs.tickets }}
  1395→
  1396→              Provide:
  1397→              1. Executive summary (2-3 sentences)
  1398→              2. Recommended next steps
  1399→              3. Flow status (reused/generated/manual)
  1400→              4. Ticket overview (count, complexity distribution)
  1401→
  1402→              Make it concise and actionable.
  1403→          output:
  1404→              summary: { type: string }

## Summary

I've successfully read both files as requested. Here's what I found:

**package.json Summary:**
- **Project name:** worker
- **Version:** 1.0.0
- Core dependencies include: flow-engine, shared-orch-worker, shared-common, ws (WebSocket), React, Ink (terminal UI), and terminal-kit
- Main scripts: `dev` (tsx watch mode), `build`, `test` (vitest), and linting with eslint

**flows.yml Summary:**
This is a comprehensive flow definition file containing multiple workflow templates:

1. **Simple flows** (simple-implement, debug-local, test-stream-json) - for basic task execution
2. **Pattern tests** (test-diamond, test-fork, test-loop) - for testing execution patterns
3. **Data flow examples** - pipeline, multi-output, ETL, fan-out/fan-in, conditional processing, build pipeline
4. **Subflow tests** - for flow composition and recursion
5. **Validation error examples** - demonstrating dependency tracking
6. **Special workflows** - user-intervention, idea-refiner for complex processes
7. **Input type examples** - demonstrating 17 different input types (text, url, integer, enum, date, file, password, etc.)

The flows.yml spans 1,800 lines and showcases the agent-fleet's workflow framework with Windows CMD-compatible scripts for testing various execution patterns and data transformations.

All issues addressed && del review-iter1.tmp 2>nul && exit /b 0)

   705→
   706→        - type: script

   713→              echo min=%min%

   715→              min: { type: string, pattern: 'min=(.*)' }
   716→
   717→        - type: script
   718→          id: calc-max

   721→          script: |

   723→              set /a max=95
   724→              echo max=%max%
   725→          output:
   726→              max: { type: string, pattern: 'max=(.*)' }

   728→        - type: script

   739→        # Intermediate: Use some results

   770→# Example 6: Conditional Data Flow
   771→data-conditional:
   772→    version: '1.0.0'
   773→    name: 'Data Flow: Conditional Processing'

   776→        mode: manual
   777→        gitStrategy: any
   778→        reusePolicy: always
   779→    inputs:
   780→        value: string
   781→    steps:
   782→        - type: script

   784→          name: 'Check Value'
   785→          script: |
   786→              echo Checking value: ${{ inputs.value }}
   787→              set /a num=${{ inputs.value }}
   788→              if %num% GTR 50 (
   789→                echo path=high
   790→                set /a category=1
   791→              ) else if %num% GTR 20 (
   792→                echo path=medium
   793→                set /a category=2
   794→              ) else (
   795→                echo path=low
   796→                set /a category=3
   797→              )
   798→              echo category=%category%

   800→              path: { type: string, pattern: 'path=(.*)' }
   801→              category: { type: string, pattern: 'category=(.*)' }
   802→
   803→        - type: script
   804→          id: process-high
   805→          name: 'High Value Processing'

   807→          when: "${{ steps.check.outputs.path === 'high' }}"
   808→          script: |
   809→              echo Processing HIGH value

   811→              echo result=%result%

   813→              result: { type: string, pattern: 'result=(.*)' }
   814→
   815→        - type: script
   816→          id: process-medium

   819→          when: "${{ steps.check.outputs.path === 'medium' }}"
   820→          script: |
   821→              echo Processing MEDIUM value
   822→              set /a result=${{ inputs.value }} * 10
   823→              echo result=%result%
   824→          output:
   825→              result: { type: string, pattern: 'result=(.*)' }
   826→
   827→        - type: script
   828→          id: process-low
   829→          name: 'Low Value Processing'
   830→          depends: [check]
   831→          when: "${{ steps.check.outputs.path === 'low' }}"
   832→          script: |
   833→              echo Processing LOW value
   834→              set /a result=${{ inputs.value }} * 2
   835→              echo result=%result%
   836→          output:
   837→              result: { type: string, pattern: 'result=(.*)' }
   838→
   839→        - type: script
   840→          id: finalize

   842→          depends: [check]
   843→          script: |

   845→              echo Final processing complete

  1171→# ============================================================================
  1172→# IDEA REFINER FLOW
  1173→# Transform high-level ideas into actionable flows and tickets
  1174→# ============================================================================
  1175→
  1176→idea-refiner:
  1177→    version: '1.0.0'
  1178→    name: 'Idea Refiner: Transform Ideas into Flows and Tickets'
  1179→    description: 'Analyzes an idea, recommends/generates flows, and creates structured tickets'
  1180→    workspace:
  1181→        mode: shared
  1182→        gitStrategy: main-only
  1183→        reusePolicy: always
  1184→    statusTransitions:
  1185→        onSuccess: approved
  1186→        onFailure: todo
  1187→    inputs:
  1188→        idea:
  1189→            type: text
  1190→            required: true
  1191→            description: 'High-level idea description'
  1192→        preferExisting:
  1193→            type: boolean
  1194→            required: false
  1195→            default: true
  1196→            description: 'Prefer reusing existing flows over generating new ones'
  1197→    steps:
  1198→        # Step 1: Analyze the idea
  1199→        - type: model
  1200→          id: analyze-idea
  1201→          name: 'Analyze Idea Requirements'
  1202→          model: sonnet
  1203→          prompt: |
  1204→              Analyze this idea and extract structured requirements:
  1205→
  1206→              Idea: ${{ inputs.idea }}
  1207→
  1208→              Extract:
  1209→              1. Core objective (what does it aim to achieve?)
  1210→              2. Required inputs (what data/parameters are needed?)
  1211→              3. Expected outputs (what should be produced?)
  1212→              4. Complexity level (simple/medium/complex)
  1213→              5. Suggested flow patterns (pipeline/conditional/loop/fan-out/etc)
  1214→              6. Required features (user approval? parallel execution? retries?)
  1215→
  1216→              Return as JSON with fields: objective, inputs, outputs, complexity, patterns, features.
  1217→              Example:
  1218→              {
  1219→                "objective": "Deploy application to production",
  1220→                "inputs": ["environment", "version"],
  1221→                "outputs": ["deploymentUrl", "status"],
  1222→                "complexity": "medium",
  1223→                "patterns": ["build-pipeline", "user-intervention"],
  1224→                "features": {
  1225→                  "userApproval": true,
  1226→                  "parallel": false,
  1227→                  "loops": false
  1228→                }
  1229→              }
  1230→          output:
  1231→              requirements:
  1232→                  type: object
  1233→                  transform: parseJSON
  1234→
  1235→        # Step 2: Search existing flows
  1236→        - type: script
  1237→          id: search-flows
  1238→          name: 'Search for Matching Flows'
  1239→          depends: [analyze-idea]
  1240→          script: node scripts/recommend-flows.js '${{ steps.analyze-idea.outputs.requirements }}'
  1241→          output:
  1242→              recommendations:
  1243→                  type: object
  1244→                  transform: parseJSON
  1245→
  1246→        # Step 3: User decision (reuse, generate, or manual)
  1247→        - type: user_intervention
  1248→          id: flow-decision
  1249→          name: 'Choose Flow Strategy'
  1250→          depends: [search-flows]
  1251→          interventionType: choice
  1252→          blocking: true
  1253→          choice:
  1254→              question: 'How would you like to proceed with this idea?'
  1255→              options:
  1256→                  - id: reuse
  1257→                    label: 'Reuse Existing Flow'
  1258→                    description: 'Adapt one of the recommended flows to match your needs'
  1259→                  - id: generate
  1260→                    label: 'Generate Custom Flow'
  1261→                    description: 'Create a new flow tailored specifically to this idea'
  1262→                  - id: manual
  1263→                    label: 'Create Manually'
  1264→                    description: 'I will create the flow manually using the documentation'
  1265→              allowMultiple: false
  1266→          output:
  1267→              decision: { type: string, from: 'intervention.choice' }
  1268→              selectedFlowId: { type: string, from: 'intervention.metadata.flowId' }
  1269→
  1270→        # Step 4a: Adapt existing flow (if reuse chosen)
  1271→        - type: model
  1272→          id: adapt-flow
  1273→          name: 'Adapt Existing Flow'
  1274→          depends: [flow-decision]
  1275→          when: "${{ steps.flow-decision.outputs.decision === 'reuse' }}"
  1276→          model: sonnet
  1277→          prompt: |
  1278→              Adapt this flow to match the requirements:
  1279→
  1280→              Original Flow:
  1281→              ${{ steps.search-flows.outputs.recommendations[0].flow }}
  1282→
  1283→              Requirements:
  1284→              ${{ steps.analyze-idea.outputs.requirements }}
  1285→
  1286→              Adaptation Suggestions:
  1287→              ${{ steps.search-flows.outputs.recommendations[0].adaptationSuggestions }}
  1288→
  1289→              Provide:
  1290→              1. Modified flow definition (YAML)
  1291→              2. List of changes made
  1292→              3. Rationale for each change
  1293→
  1294→              Return as JSON with fields: flowYaml (string), changes (array), rationale (string).
  1295→          output:
  1296→              flowYaml: { type: string }

              echo [A] Initializing fork flow: ${{ inputs.task }} && ping localhost -n 2 >nul && echo [A] Waiting 2 seconds... && ping localhost -n 2 >nul && echo [A] Ready to fork into 3 parallel branches!

        # Fork: B, C, and D run in parallel with different delays
        - type: script
          id: step-b
          name: 'Step B (Security Audit)'
          depends: [step-a]
          script: |
              echo [B] Starting security audit... && ping localhost -n 2 >nul && echo [B] Phase 1: Scanning dependencies (3s) && ping localhost -n 4 >nul && echo [B] Phase 2: Checking vulnerabilities (4s) && ping localhost -n 5 >nul && echo [B] Phase 3: Generating report (2s) && ping localhost -n 3 >nul && echo [B] Security audit complete!

        - type: script
          id: step-c
          name: 'Step C (Code Linting)'
          depends: [step-a]
          script: |
              echo [C] Starting linting process... && ping localhost -n 2 >nul && echo [C] Phase 1: Loading rules (2s) && ping localhost -n 3 >nul && echo [C] Phase 2: Analyzing code (5s) && ping localhost -n 6 >nul && echo [C] Phase 3: Fixing auto-fixable issues (1s) && ping localhost -n 2 >nul && echo [C] Linting complete - no errors!

        - type: script
          id: step-d
          name: 'Step D (Test Suite)'
          depends: [step-a]
          script: |
              echo [D] Starting test suite... && ping localhost -n 2 >nul && echo [D] Phase 1: Setup test environment (3s) && ping localhost -n 4 >nul && echo [D] Phase 2: Running unit tests (6s) && ping localhost -n 7 >nul && echo [D] Phase 3: Running integration tests (4s) && ping localhost -n 5 >nul && echo [D] Phase 4: Cleanup (2s) && ping localhost -n 3 >nul && echo [D] All tests passed!

# Test Flow 3: Feedback Loop (test-loop)
# Tests onFailure.goto with iteration tracking
# Flow: implement → test (fails 2x, succeeds 3rd time) → done
test-loop:
    version: '1.0.0'
    name: 'Test: Feedback Loop (Retry Pattern)'
    description: 'Tests onFailure.goto with a test step that fails twice then succeeds'
    workspace:
        mode: manual
        gitStrategy: any
        reusePolicy: always
    statusTransitions:
        onSuccess: approved
        onFailure: todo
    inputs:
        message: string
    steps:
        # Step 1: implement (always succeeds)
        - type: script
          id: implement
          name: 'Implement Feature'
          script: |
              echo [implement] Starting implementation: ${{ inputs.message }} && ping localhost -n 2 >nul && echo [implement] Writing code... && ping localhost -n 3 >nul && echo [implement] Implementation complete!

        # Step 2: test (fails first 2 times, succeeds on 3rd)
        - type: script
          id: test
          name: 'Run Tests'
          depends: [implement]
          onFailure:
              goto: implement
              maxIterations: 3
          script: |
              echo [test] Running test suite... && ping localhost -n 2 >nul && if not exist test-iter1.tmp (echo First iteration - FAIL && echo. > test-iter1.tmp && exit /b 1) else if not exist test-iter2.tmp (echo Second iteration - FAIL && echo. > test-iter2.tmp && exit /b 1) else (echo Third iteration - PASS && del test-iter1.tmp test-iter2.tmp 2>nul && exit /b 0)

        # Step 3: done (only runs after tests pass)
        - type: script
          id: done
          name: 'Complete'
          depends: [test]
          script: |
              echo [done] All steps completed successfully! Flow finished.

# Test Flow 4: Review Feedback Loop (test-review-loop)
# Tests onFailure.goto with a review step that provides feedback
# Flow: implement → review (fails 1st, passes 2nd) → deploy
test-review-loop:
    version: '1.0.0'
    name: 'Test: Review Feedback Loop'
    description: 'Tests onFailure.goto with a review step that fails once then approves'
    workspace:
        mode: manual
        gitStrategy: any
        reusePolicy: always
    statusTransitions:
        onSuccess: approved
        onFailure: changes_requested
    inputs:
        feature: string
    steps:
        # Step 1: implement
        - type: script
          id: implement
          name: 'Implement Feature'
          script: |
              echo [implement] Implementing feature: ${{ inputs.feature }} && ping localhost -n 2 >nul && echo [implement] Adding new code... && ping localhost -n 2 >nul && if exist review-feedback.tmp (echo [implement] Applying feedback from review && ping localhost -n 2 >nul && del review-feedback.tmp 2>nul) && echo [implement] Implementation ready for review

        # Step 2: review (fails first time with feedback, passes second time)
        - type: script
          id: review
          name: 'Code Review'
          depends: [implement]
          onFailure:
              goto: implement
              maxIterations: 2
          script: |
              echo [review] Starting code review... && ping localhost -n 2 >nul && if not exist review-iter1.tmp (echo [review] CHANGES REQUESTED: Please add error handling && echo. > review-iter1.tmp && echo. > review-feedback.tmp && exit /b 1) else (echo [review] Code review APPROVED! All issues addressed && del review-iter1.tmp 2>nul && exit /b 0)

        # Step 3: deploy (only runs after review passes)
        - type: script
          id: deploy
          name: 'Deploy to Production'
          depends: [review]
          script: |
              echo [deploy] Deploying approved code to production... && ping localhost -n 3 >nul && echo [deploy] Deployment successful!

# Test Flow 5: Multi-Review with skipOnLoop and resetOnSuccess
# Tests advanced loop features: multiple reviews, some skipped on retry
# Flow: implement → (quality + security + consistency + usability) → deploy
test-multi-review:
    version: '1.0.0'
    name: 'Test: Multi-Review with Skip and Reset'
    description: 'Tests skipOnLoop and resetOnSuccess with parallel review steps'
    workspace:
        mode: manual
        gitStrategy: any
        reusePolicy: always
    statusTransitions:
        onSuccess: approved
        onFailure: changes_requested
    inputs:
        feature: string
    steps:
        # Step 1: implement
        - type: script
          id: implement
          name: 'Implement Feature'
          script: |
              echo [implement] Implementing feature: ${{ inputs.feature }} && ping localhost -n 2 >nul && echo [implement] Code complete

        # Step 2-5: Multiple reviews run in parallel
        # Quality review only runs once (skipOnLoop=true)
        - type: script
          id: review-quality
          name: 'Code Quality Review'
          depends: [implement]
          skipOnLoop: true
          script: |
              echo [quality] Checking code quality... && ping localhost -n 2 >nul && echo [quality] Quality standards met!

        # Security review can trigger loop, with resetOnSuccess
        - type: script
          id: review-security
          name: 'Security Review'
          depends: [implement]
          onFailure:
              goto: implement
              maxIterations: 2
              resetOnSuccess: true
          script: |
              echo [security] Running security audit... && ping localhost -n 2 >nul && if not exist security-pass.tmp (echo [security] SECURITY ISSUE FOUND - Fix required && echo. > security-pass.tmp && exit /b 1) else (echo [security] Security approved! && del security-pass.tmp 2>nul && exit /b 0)

        # Consistency review only runs once (skipOnLoop=true)
        - type: script
          id: review-consistency
          name: 'Code Consistency Review'
          depends: [implement]
          skipOnLoop: true
          script: |
              echo [consistency] Checking code consistency... && ping localhost -n 2 >nul && echo [consistency] Consistent with project standards!

        # Usability review can trigger loop, with resetOnSuccess
        - type: script
          id: review-usability
          name: 'Usability Review'
          depends: [implement]
          onFailure:
              goto: implement
              maxIterations: 2
              resetOnSuccess: true
          script: |
              echo [usability] Reviewing user experience... && ping localhost -n 2 >nul && if not exist usability-pass.tmp (echo [usability] USABILITY ISSUE - Improve UX && echo. > usability-pass.tmp && exit /b 1) else (echo [usability] UX approved! && del usability-pass.tmp 2>nul && exit /b 0)

        # Step 6: deploy (waits for all reviews)
        - type: script
          id: deploy
          name: 'Deploy to Production'
          depends: [review-quality, review-security, review-consistency, review-usability]
          script: |
              echo [deploy] All reviews passed! Deploying to production... && ping localhost -n 3 >nul && echo [deploy] Deployment complete!

# SubFlowStep Test Flows (Phase 1 MVP)
# Test basic flow composition with 'inherit' workspace strategy

# Atomic flow: Simple echo
test-echo:
    version: '1.0.0'
    name: 'Test: Echo Flow'
    description: 'Simple echo flow used for testing subflow composition'
    workspace:
        mode: manual
        gitStrategy: any
        reusePolicy: always
    inputs:
        message: string
    steps:
        - type: script
          id: echo
          name: 'Echo Message'
          script: 'echo "${{ inputs.message }}"'
          output:
              result: { type: string }

# Composite flow: Calls echo twice
test-subflow-basic:
    version: '1.0.0'
    name: 'Test: Basic SubFlow'
    description: 'Tests basic subflow execution with inherit strategy'
    workspace:
        mode: manual
        gitStrategy: any
        reusePolicy: always
    inputs:
        greeting: string
    steps:
        - type: subflow
          id: first-echo
          name: 'First Echo'
          flowId: test-echo
          inputs:
              message: '${{ inputs.greeting }}'
          output:
              echo1: '${{ steps.echo.outputs.result }}'

        - type: subflow
          id: second-echo
          name: 'Second Echo'
          flowId: test-echo
          depends: [first-echo]
          inputs:
              message: 'Reply: ${{ steps.first-echo.outputs.echo1 }}'

# Nested subflows: Test recursion depth tracking
test-subflow-nested:
    version: '1.0.0'
    name: 'Test: Nested SubFlows'
    description: 'Tests nested subflow execution (3 levels deep)'
    workspace:
        mode: manual
        gitStrategy: any
        reusePolicy: always
    inputs:
        msg: string
    steps:
        - type: subflow
          id: call-basic
          name: 'Call Basic SubFlow'
          flowId: test-subflow-basic
          inputs:
              greeting: '${{ inputs.msg }}'

# Recursive flow: Countdown from N to 0
test-recursive-countdown:
    version: '1.0.0'
    name: 'Test: Recursive Countdown'
    description: 'Tests recursive SubFlowStep with exit condition (counts from N to 0)'
    workspace:
        mode: manual
        gitStrategy: any
        reusePolicy: always
    inputs:
        count: string
    steps:
        - type: script
          id: display
          name: 'Display Count'
          script: 'echo "Count: ${{ inputs.count }}"'

        - type: script
          id: calculate
          name: 'Calculate Next'
          script: |
              set /a next=${{ inputs.count }}-1 >nul
              echo next=%next%
              if %next% GEQ 0 (echo continue=true) else (echo continue=false)
          output:
              next: { type: string, pattern: 'next=(.*)' }
              continue: { type: string, pattern: 'continue=(.*)' }

        - type: subflow
          id: recurse
          name: 'Recurse if count > 0'
          flowId: test-recursive-countdown
          allowRecursion: true
          when: "${{ steps.calculate.outputs.continue === 'true' }}"
          depends: [calculate]
          inputs:
              count: '${{ steps.calculate.outputs.next }}'

# Data Flow Examples - Progressive complexity for visualization

# Example 1: Simple Linear Pipeline (A → B → C)
data-simple-pipeline:
    version: '1.0.0'
    name: 'Data Flow: Simple Pipeline'
    description: 'Linear data flow: generate → transform → display'
    workspace:
        mode: manual
        gitStrategy: any
        reusePolicy: always
    inputs:
        seed: string
    steps:
        - type: script
          id: generate
          name: 'Generate Data'
          script: |
              echo Input seed: ${{ inputs.seed }}
              set /a value=${{ inputs.seed }} * 10
              echo value=%value%
          output:
              value: { type: string, pattern: 'value=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: transform
          name: 'Transform Data'
          depends: [generate]
          script: |
              echo Received: ${{ steps.generate.outputs.value }}
              set /a doubled=${{ steps.generate.outputs.value }} * 2
              echo doubled=%doubled%
          output:
              doubled: { type: string, pattern: 'doubled=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: display
          name: 'Display Result'
          depends: [transform]
          script: |
              echo Final result: ${{ steps.transform.outputs.doubled }}
              echo Original seed was ${{ inputs.seed }}, final value is ${{ steps.transform.outputs.doubled }}

# Example 2: Multi-Output Pipeline (one step produces multiple outputs)
data-multi-output:
    version: '1.0.0'
    name: 'Data Flow: Multi-Output'
    description: 'One step generates multiple outputs used by different consumers'
    workspace:
        mode: manual
        gitStrategy: any
        reusePolicy: always
    inputs:
        number: string
    steps:
        - type: script
          id: calculate
          name: 'Calculate Multiple Values'
          script: |
              echo Processing: ${{ inputs.number }}
              set /a sum=${{ inputs.number }} + 100
              set /a product=${{ inputs.number }} * 5
              set /a square=${{ inputs.number }} * ${{ inputs.number }}
              echo sum=%sum%
              echo product=%product%
              echo square=%square%
          output:
              sum: { type: string, pattern: 'sum=(.*)' }
              product: { type: string, pattern: 'product=(.*)' }
              square: { type: string, pattern: 'square=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: use-sum
          name: 'Process Sum'
          depends: [calculate]
          script: |
              echo Sum result: ${{ steps.calculate.outputs.sum }}
              set /a result=${{ steps.calculate.outputs.sum }} + 10
              echo result=%result%
          output:
              result: { type: string, pattern: 'result=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: use-product
          name: 'Process Product'
          depends: [calculate]
          script: |
              echo Product result: ${{ steps.calculate.outputs.product }}
              set /a result=${{ steps.calculate.outputs.product }} / 5
              echo result=%result%
          output:
              result: { type: string, pattern: 'result=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: merge
          name: 'Merge Results'
          depends: [use-sum, use-product]
          script: |
              echo Merging: sum_result=${{ steps.use-sum.outputs.result }}, product_result=${{ steps.use-product.outputs.result }}
              echo Original square was: ${{ steps.calculate.outputs.square }}
              set /a final=${{ steps.use-sum.outputs.result }} + ${{ steps.use-product.outputs.result }}
              echo final=%final%
          output:
              final: { type: string, pattern: 'final=(.*)' }

# Example 3: Diamond with Data Flow
data-diamond:
    version: '1.0.0'
    name: 'Data Flow: Diamond Pattern'
    description: 'Fork and join with data transformations at each step'
    workspace:
        mode: manual
        gitStrategy: any
        reusePolicy: always
    inputs:
        value: string
    steps:
        - type: script
          id: source
          name: 'Data Source'
          script: |
              echo Starting with: ${{ inputs.value }}
              set /a base=${{ inputs.value }} * 2
              echo base=%base%
          output:
              base: { type: string, pattern: 'base=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: branch-a
          name: 'Branch A: Add'
          depends: [source]
          script: |
              echo Branch A processing: ${{ steps.source.outputs.base }}
              set /a result=${{ steps.source.outputs.base }} + 50
              echo result=%result%
          output:
              result: { type: string, pattern: 'result=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: branch-b
          name: 'Branch B: Multiply'
          depends: [source]
          script: |
              echo Branch B processing: ${{ steps.source.outputs.base }}
              set /a result=${{ steps.source.outputs.base }} * 3
              echo result=%result%
          output:
              result: { type: string, pattern: 'result=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: combine
          name: 'Combine Results'
          depends: [branch-a, branch-b]
          script: |
              echo Combining A=${{ steps.branch-a.outputs.result }} and B=${{ steps.branch-b.outputs.result }}
              set /a combined=${{ steps.branch-a.outputs.result }} + ${{ steps.branch-b.outputs.result }}
              echo combined=%combined%
          output:
              combined: { type: string, pattern: 'combined=(.*)' }

# Example 4: ETL Pattern (Extract → Transform → Load)
data-etl:
    version: '1.0.0'
    name: 'Data Flow: ETL Pattern'
    description: 'Extract, Transform, Load pattern with multiple transformations'
    workspace:
        mode: manual
        gitStrategy: any
        reusePolicy: always
    inputs:
        source: string
    steps:
        - type: script
          id: extract
          name: 'Extract Data'
          script: |
              echo Extracting from: ${{ inputs.source }}
              echo raw_data=user123,active,premium
          output:
              raw_data: { type: string, pattern: 'raw_data=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: parse
          name: 'Parse Fields'
          depends: [extract]
          script: |
              echo Parsing: ${{ steps.extract.outputs.raw_data }}
              echo user_id=user123
              echo status=active
              echo tier=premium
          output:
              user_id: { type: string, pattern: 'user_id=(.*)' }
              status: { type: string, pattern: 'status=(.*)' }
              tier: { type: string, pattern: 'tier=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: validate
          name: 'Validate Data'
          depends: [parse]
          script: |
              echo Validating user: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.user_id }}
              echo Status: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.status }}
              echo Tier: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.tier }}
              echo valid=true
          output:
              valid: { type: string, pattern: 'valid=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: enrich
          name: 'Enrich Data'
          depends: [validate]
          script: |
              echo Enriching: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.user_id }}
              echo credits=1000
              echo expiry=2025-12-31
          output:
              credits: { type: string, pattern: 'credits=(.*)' }
              expiry: { type: string, pattern: 'expiry=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: load
          name: 'Load to Database'
          depends: [enrich]
          script: |
              echo Loading to database:
              echo - User: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.user_id }}
              echo - Status: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.status }}
              echo - Tier: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.tier }}
              echo - Credits: ${{ steps.enrich.outputs.credits }}
              echo - Expiry: ${{ steps.enrich.outputs.expiry }}
              echo loaded=success

# Example 5: Complex Fan-Out Fan-In
data-fanout-fanin:
    version: '1.0.0'
    name: 'Data Flow: Fan-Out/Fan-In'
    description: 'Complex pattern with multiple parallel transformations and aggregation'
    workspace:
        mode: manual
        gitStrategy: any
        reusePolicy: always
    inputs:
        dataset: string
    steps:
        - type: script
          id: prepare
          name: 'Prepare Dataset'
          script: |
              echo Preparing dataset: ${{ inputs.dataset }}
              set /a count=100
              set /a total=5000
              echo count=%count%
              echo total=%total%
          output:
              count: { type: string, pattern: 'count=(.*)' }
              total: { type: string, pattern: 'total=(.*)' }

        # Fan-out: Multiple parallel processors
        - type: script
          id: calc-average
          name: 'Calculate Average'
          depends: [prepare]
          script: |
              echo Calculating average from total=${{ steps.prepare.outputs.total }}, count=${{ steps.prepare.outputs.count }}
              set /a avg=${{ steps.prepare.outputs.total }} / ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.count }}
              echo average=%avg%
          output:
              average: { type: string, pattern: 'average=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: calc-min
          name: 'Find Minimum'
          depends: [prepare]
          script: |
              echo Finding min in dataset
              set /a min=5
              echo min=%min%
          output:
              min: { type: string, pattern: 'min=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: calc-max
          name: 'Find Maximum'
          depends: [prepare]
          script: |
              echo Finding max in dataset
              set /a max=95
              echo max=%max%
          output:
              max: { type: string, pattern: 'max=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: calc-stddev
          name: 'Calculate Std Dev'
          depends: [prepare]
          script: |
              echo Calculating standard deviation
              set /a stddev=15
              echo stddev=%stddev%
          output:
              stddev: { type: string, pattern: 'stddev=(.*)' }

        # Intermediate: Use some results
        - type: script
          id: calc-range
          name: 'Calculate Range'
          depends: [calc-min, calc-max]
          script: |
              echo Range calculation: max=${{ steps.calc-max.outputs.max }}, min=${{ steps.calc-min.outputs.min }}
              set /a range=${{ steps.calc-max.outputs.max }} - ${{ steps.calc-min.outputs.min }}
              echo range=%range%
          output:
              range: { type: string, pattern: 'range=(.*)' }

        # Fan-in: Aggregate all statistics
        - type: script
          id: generate-report
          name: 'Generate Statistics Report'
          depends: [calc-average, calc-range, calc-stddev]
          script: |
              echo === Statistics Report ===
              echo Dataset: ${{ inputs.dataset }}
              echo Count: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.count }}
              echo Total: ${{ steps.prepare.outputs.total }}
              echo Average: ${{ steps.calc-average.outputs.average }}
              echo Min: ${{ steps.calc-min.outputs.min }}
              echo Max: ${{ steps.calc-max.outputs.max }}
              echo Range: ${{ steps.calc-range.outputs.range }}
              echo StdDev: ${{ steps.calc-stddev.outputs.stddev }}
              echo report=generated
          output:
              report: { type: string, pattern: 'report=(.*)' }

# Example 6: Conditional Data Flow
data-conditional:
    version: '1.0.0'
    name: 'Data Flow: Conditional Processing'
    description: 'Data flows through different paths based on conditions'
    workspace:
        mode: manual
        gitStrategy: any
        reusePolicy: always
    inputs:
        value: string
    steps:
        - type: script
          id: check
          name: 'Check Value'
          script: |
              echo Checking value: ${{ inputs.value }}
              set /a num=${{ inputs.value }}
              if %num% GTR 50 (
                echo path=high
                set /a category=1
              ) else if %num% GTR 20 (
                echo path=medium
                set /a category=2
              ) else (
                echo path=low
                set /a category=3
              )
              echo category=%category%
          output:
              path: { type: string, pattern: 'path=(.*)' }
              category: { type: string, pattern: 'category=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: process-high
          name: 'High Value Processing'
          depends: [check]
          when: "${{ steps.check.outputs.path === 'high' }}"
          script: |
              echo Processing HIGH value
              set /a result=${{ inputs.value }} * 100
              echo result=%result%
          output:
              result: { type: string, pattern: 'result=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: process-medium
          name: 'Medium Value Processing'
          depends: [check]
          when: "${{ steps.check.outputs.path === 'medium' }}"
          script: |
              echo Processing MEDIUM value
              set /a result=${{ inputs.value }} * 10
              echo result=%result%
          output:
              result: { type: string, pattern: 'result=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: process-low
          name: 'Low Value Processing'
          depends: [check]
          when: "${{ steps.check.outputs.path === 'low' }}"
          script: |
              echo Processing LOW value
              set /a result=${{ inputs.value }} * 2
              echo result=%result%
          output:
              result: { type: string, pattern: 'result=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: finalize
          name: 'Finalize Processing'
          depends: [check]
          script: |
              echo Finalizing for category: ${{ steps.check.outputs.category }}
              echo Final processing complete

# Example 7: Build Pipeline (realistic CI/CD example)
data-build-pipeline:

    name: 'Data Flow: Build Pipeline'
    description: 'CI/CD pipeline with compile, test, and package steps'

        mode: manual
        gitStrategy: any
        reusePolicy: always

        version: string

          id: checkout
          name: 'Checkout Code'
          script: |
              echo Checking out version: ${{ inputs.version }}
              echo commit=abc123def
              echo branch=main
          output:
              commit: { type: string, pattern: 'commit=(.*)' }
              branch: { type: string, pattern: 'branch=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: install-deps
          name: 'Install Dependencies'
          depends: [checkout]
          script: |
              echo Installing dependencies for commit ${{ steps.checkout.outputs.commit }}
              ping localhost -n 2 >nul
              echo deps_installed=true
              echo deps_count=142
          output:
              deps_installed: { type: string, pattern: 'deps_installed=(.*)' }
              deps_count: { type: string, pattern: 'deps_count=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: compile
          name: 'Compile Source'
          depends: [install-deps]

              echo Compiling with ${{ steps.install-deps.outputs.deps_count }} dependencies

              echo artifacts=dist/bundle.js
              echo size=2048
          output:
              artifacts: { type: string, pattern: 'artifacts=(.*)' }
              size: { type: string, pattern: 'size=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: test-unit
          name: 'Run Unit Tests'
          depends: [compile]
          script: |
              echo Running unit tests on ${{ steps.compile.outputs.artifacts }}
              ping localhost -n 2 >nul
              echo tests_passed=45
              echo tests_failed=0
          output:
              tests_passed: { type: string, pattern: 'tests_passed=(.*)' }
              tests_failed: { type: string, pattern: 'tests_failed=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: test-integration
          name: 'Run Integration Tests'
          depends: [compile]
          script: |
              echo Running integration tests
              ping localhost -n 3 >nul
              echo tests_passed=12
              echo tests_failed=0
          output:
              tests_passed: { type: string, pattern: 'tests_passed=(.*)' }
              tests_failed: { type: string, pattern: 'tests_failed=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: analyze-coverage
          name: 'Analyze Test Coverage'
          depends: [test-unit, test-integration]
          script: |
              echo Analyzing coverage from unit and integration tests
              echo Unit: ${{ steps.test-unit.outputs.tests_passed }} passed
              echo Integration: ${{ steps.test-integration.outputs.tests_passed }} passed
              set /a total=${{ steps.test-unit.outputs.tests_passed }} + ${{ steps.test-integration.outputs.tests_passed }}
              echo coverage=87
              echo total_tests=%total%
          output:
              coverage: { type: string, pattern: 'coverage=(.*)' }
              total_tests: { type: string, pattern: 'total_tests=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: package
          name: 'Package Application'
          depends: [analyze-coverage]
          script: |
              echo Packaging version ${{ inputs.version }}
              echo Artifact: ${{ steps.compile.outputs.artifacts }}
              echo Size: ${{ steps.compile.outputs.size }}KB
              echo Coverage: ${{ steps.analyze-coverage.outputs.coverage }}%%
              echo package=app-${{ inputs.version }}.zip
          output:
              package: { type: string, pattern: 'package=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: publish
          name: 'Publish Artifacts'
          depends: [package]
          script: |
              echo Publishing ${{ steps.package.outputs.package }}
              echo Branch: ${{ steps.checkout.outputs.branch }}
              echo Commit: ${{ steps.checkout.outputs.commit }}
              echo url=https://artifacts.example.com/${{ steps.package.outputs.package }}
          output:

# VALIDATION ERROR EXAMPLES
# These flows demonstrate errors that the new validation system will catch
# ============================================================================

# Example 1: Missing Dependency Error
# ❌ ERROR: step2 uses step1.outputs.result but does not depend on step1
validation-error-missing-dependency:
    version: '1.0.0'
    name: 'Validation Error: Missing Dependency'
    description: 'Demonstrates variable usage without proper dependency declaration'
    workspace:
        mode: isolated
        gitStrategy: main-only
        reusePolicy: always
    inputs:
        number: string
    steps:
        - type: script
          id: step1
          name: 'Calculate Square'
          script: |
              set /a result=${{ inputs.number }} * ${{ inputs.number }}
              echo result=%result%
          output:
              result: { type: string, pattern: 'result=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: step2
          name: 'Use Result (MISSING DEPENDENCY)'
          # ❌ ERROR: Uses step1.outputs.result but no depends: [step1]
          script: |
              echo The square is ${{ steps.step1.outputs.result }}
              echo status=done
          output:
              status: { type: string, pattern: 'status=(.*)' }

# Example 2: Undefined Output Warning
# ⚠️ WARNING: References output fields not defined in step's output config
validation-error-undefined-output:
    version: '1.0.0'
    name: 'Validation Error: Undefined Output'
    description: 'Demonstrates referencing outputs that are not declared'
    workspace:
        mode: isolated
        gitStrategy: main-only
        reusePolicy: always
    inputs:
        task: string
    steps:
        - type: model
          id: analyze
          name: 'Analyze Task'
          model: haiku
          prompt: 'Analyze: ${{ inputs.task }}'
          output:
              analysis: { type: string }
              # Note: Only 'analysis' is defined, not 'summary' or 'recommendations'

        - type: model
          id: report
          name: 'Generate Report'
          depends: [analyze]
          model: haiku
          prompt: |
              Analysis: ${{ steps.analyze.outputs.analysis }}
              Summary: ${{ steps.analyze.outputs.summary }}
              Recommendations: ${{ steps.analyze.outputs.recommendations }}
          # ⚠️ WARNING: 'summary' and 'recommendations' not defined in step 'analyze'

# Example 3: Missing Transitive Dependency
# ❌ ERROR: step3 uses step1 output but only depends on step2 (which doesn't depend on step1)
validation-error-transitive-missing:
    version: '1.0.0'
    name: 'Validation Error: Missing Transitive Dependency'
    description: 'Demonstrates missing transitive dependency in variable usage'
    workspace:
        mode: isolated
        gitStrategy: main-only
        reusePolicy: always
    inputs:
        value: string
    steps:
        - type: script
          id: step1
          name: 'Process Value'
          script: |
              echo processed=${{ inputs.value }}_processed
          output:
              processed: { type: string, pattern: 'processed=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: step2
          name: 'Independent Step'
          # No dependency on step1
          script: |
              echo independent=true
          output:
              independent: { type: string, pattern: 'independent=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: step3
          name: 'Use step1 Output (INVALID)'
          depends: [step2]
          # ❌ ERROR: Uses step1.outputs.processed but step2 doesn't depend on step1
          # This creates an invalid dependency chain: step3 → step2 (but step2 doesn't depend on step1)
          script: |
              echo Using processed value: ${{ steps.step1.outputs.processed }}
              echo Using independent: ${{ steps.step2.outputs.independent }}
              echo final=complete
          output:
              final: { type: string, pattern: 'final=(.*)' }

# Example 4: Correct Usage (For Comparison)
# ✅ VALID: All dependencies properly declared
validation-correct-example:
    version: '1.0.0'
    name: 'Validation: Correct Example'
    description: 'Demonstrates correct variable usage with proper dependencies'
    workspace:
        mode: isolated
        gitStrategy: main-only
        reusePolicy: always
    inputs:
        number: string
    steps:
        - type: script
          id: step1
          name: 'Calculate'
          script: |
              set /a result=${{ inputs.number }} * 2
              echo result=%result%
          output:
              result: { type: string, pattern: 'result=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: step2
          name: 'Use Result (CORRECT)'
          depends: [step1] # ✅ Correctly depends on step1
          script: |
              echo The result is ${{ steps.step1.outputs.result }}
              echo status=done
          output:
              status: { type: string, pattern: 'status=(.*)' }

        - type: script
          id: step3
          name: 'Use Both (CORRECT - Transitive)'
          depends: [step2] # ✅ Transitive: step3 → step2 → step1
          script: |
              echo Original result: ${{ steps.step1.outputs.result }}
              echo Status: ${{ steps.step2.outputs.status }}

# ============================================================================
# IDEA REFINER FLOW
# Transform high-level ideas into actionable flows and tickets
# ============================================================================

idea-refiner:
    version: '1.0.0'
    name: 'Idea Refiner: Transform Ideas into Flows and Tickets'
    description: 'Analyzes an idea, recommends/generates flows, and creates structured tickets'
    workspace:
        mode: shared
        gitStrategy: main-only
        reusePolicy: always
    statusTransitions:
        onSuccess: approved
        onFailure: todo
    inputs:
        idea:
            type: text
            required: true
            description: 'High-level idea description'
        preferExisting:
            type: boolean
            required: false
            default: true
            description: 'Prefer reusing existing flows over generating new ones'
    steps:
        # Step 1: Analyze the idea
        - type: model
          id: analyze-idea
          name: 'Analyze Idea Requirements'
          model: sonnet
          prompt: |
              Analyze this idea and extract structured requirements:

              Idea: ${{ inputs.idea }}

              Extract:
              1. Core objective (what does it aim to achieve?)
              2. Required inputs (what data/parameters are needed?)
              3. Expected outputs (what should be produced?)
              4. Complexity level (simple/medium/complex)
              5. Suggested flow patterns (pipeline/conditional/loop/fan-out/etc)
              6. Required features (user approval? parallel execution? retries?)

              Return as JSON with fields: objective, inputs, outputs, complexity, patterns, features.
              Example:
              {
                "objective": "Deploy application to production",
                "inputs": ["environment", "version"],
                "outputs": ["deploymentUrl", "status"],
                "complexity": "medium",
                "patterns": ["build-pipeline", "user-intervention"],
                "features": {
                  "userApproval": true,
                  "parallel": false,
                  "loops": false
                }
              }
          output:
              requirements:
                  type: object
                  transform: parseJSON

        # Step 2: Search existing flows
        - type: script
          id: search-flows
          name: 'Search for Matching Flows'
          depends: [analyze-idea]
          script: node scripts/recommend-flows.js '${{ steps.analyze-idea.outputs.requirements }}'
          output:
              recommendations:
                  type: object
                  transform: parseJSON

        # Step 3: User decision (reuse, generate, or manual)
        - type: user_intervention
          id: flow-decision
          name: 'Choose Flow Strategy'
          depends: [search-flows]
          interventionType: choice
          blocking: true
          choice:
              question: 'How would you like to proceed with this idea?'
              options:
                  - id: reuse
                    label: 'Reuse Existing Flow'
                    description: 'Adapt one of the recommended flows to match your needs'
                  - id: generate
                    label: 'Generate Custom Flow'
                    description: 'Create a new flow tailored specifically to this idea'
                  - id: manual
                    label: 'Create Manually'
                    description: 'I will create the flow manually using the documentation'
              allowMultiple: false
          output:
              decision: { type: string, from: 'intervention.choice' }
              selectedFlowId: { type: string, from: 'intervention.metadata.flowId' }

        # Step 4a: Adapt existing flow (if reuse chosen)
        - type: model
          id: adapt-flow
          name: 'Adapt Existing Flow'
          depends: [flow-decision]
          when: "${{ steps.flow-decision.outputs.decision === 'reuse' }}"
          model: sonnet
          prompt: |
              Adapt this flow to match the requirements:

              Original Flow:
              ${{ steps.search-flows.outputs.recommendations[0].flow }}

              Requirements:
              ${{ steps.analyze-idea.outputs.requirements }}

              Adaptation Suggestions:
              ${{ steps.search-flows.outputs.recommendations[0].adaptationSuggestions }}

              Provide:
              1. Modified flow definition (YAML)
              2. List of changes made
              3. Rationale for each change

              Return as JSON with fields: flowYaml (string), changes (array), rationale (string).
          output:
              flowYaml: { type: string }
              changes: { type: object, transform: parseJSON }

        # Step 4b: Generate new flow (if generate chosen)
        - type: script
          id: generate-flow
          name: 'Generate Custom Flow'
          depends: [flow-decision]
          when: "${{ steps.flow-decision.outputs.decision === 'generate' }}"
          script: |
              $requirements = '${{ steps.analyze-idea.outputs.requirements }}'
              $flowReq = @{
                  id = "generated-flow-$(Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd-HHmmss')"
                  name = "Generated Flow"
                  description = '${{ inputs.idea }}'
                  inputs = $requirements.inputs
                  expectedOutputs = $requirements.outputs
                  patterns = $requirements.patterns
                  constraints = $requirements.features
              } | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
              node scripts/generate-flow.js "$flowReq"
          output:
              flowYaml: { type: string }
              validationReport: { type: object, transform: parseJSON }

        # Step 5: Validate flow (for reuse/generate paths)
        - type: script
          id: validate-flow
          name: 'Validate Flow Definition'
          depends: [adapt-flow, generate-flow]
          when: "${{ steps.flow-decision.outputs.decision !== 'manual' }}"
          script: |
              $yaml = if ('${{ steps.adapt-flow.outputs.flowYaml }}' -ne '') {
                  '${{ steps.adapt-flow.outputs.flowYaml }}'
              } else {
                  '${{ steps.generate-flow.outputs.flowYaml }}'
              }
              node scripts/validate-flow.js "$yaml"
          output:
              isValid: { type: boolean }
              errors: { type: object, transform: parseJSON }
              warnings: { type: object, transform: parseJSON }

        # Step 6: Generate tickets
        - type: model
          id: generate-tickets
          name: 'Generate Structured Tickets'
          depends: [flow-decision, validate-flow]
          model: sonnet
          prompt: |
              Generate structured tickets for implementing this idea:

              Original Idea: ${{ inputs.idea }}
              Requirements: ${{ steps.analyze-idea.outputs.requirements }}
              Flow Strategy: ${{ steps.flow-decision.outputs.decision }}

              Flow YAML (if applicable):
              ${{ steps.adapt-flow.outputs.flowYaml || steps.generate-flow.outputs.flowYaml }}

              Validation Results:
              Valid: ${{ steps.validate-flow.outputs.isValid }}
              Errors: ${{ steps.validate-flow.outputs.errors }}

              Create tickets with:
              - Title (clear, actionable)
              - Description (detailed context)
              - Acceptance criteria (specific, testable)
              - Dependencies (what must be done first)
              - Estimated complexity (1-5 scale)
              - Labels/tags

              Return as JSON array:
              [
                {
                  "title": "Ticket title",
                  "description": "Detailed description",
                  "acceptanceCriteria": ["Criterion 1", "Criterion 2"],
                  "dependencies": ["ticket-id-1"],
                  "complexity": 3,
                  "labels": ["backend", "api"]
                }
              ]
          output:
              tickets:
                  type: object
                  transform: parseJSON

        # Step 7: Present results
        - type: model
          id: present-results
          name: 'Present Results Summary'
          depends: [generate-tickets]
          model: haiku
          prompt: |
              Create a summary of the idea refinement process:

              Idea: ${{ inputs.idea }}
              Strategy: ${{ steps.flow-decision.outputs.decision }}
              Tickets Generated: ${{ steps.generate-tickets.outputs.tickets }}

              Provide:
              1. Executive summary (2-3 sentences)
              2. Recommended next steps
              3. Flow status (reused/generated/manual)
              4. Ticket overview (count, complexity distribution)

              Make it concise and actionable.
          output:
              summary: { type: string }

   770→# Example 6: Conditional Data Flow
